h1: Beauty Product Video Ads Built Around a Daily Routine
lead: Shoppers buy skincare they can picture using. Upload one product photo and get a routine-led beauty clip for TikTok, Reels and product pages.
benefits_h2: Why sellers choose beauty video templates

benefits.t: Show the routine, not just the bottle
benefits.d: A 9:16 clip places the product in a believable morning or evening moment, so shoppers see when and how they would use it. The packaging stays the focus from the first frame.

benefits.t: Texture that still photos cannot show
benefits.d: Show a dropper lift, two drops on a fingertip, a pump press or a swatch on the back of a hand. Buyers see cream, gel or oil consistency without booking a close-up shoot.
Run an evening-routine version, a hands-only texture shot or a sidewalk creator review from the same source photo. Test which angle gets attention without reshooting.

Add shade names, ingredient lines and usage instructions as editable text after download, and keep any result claim to approved wording. Clips carry no AIVideosUGC watermark and are yours for commercial use.

faq.q: What is a beauty product video template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made beauty scene. Add your own skincare photo and generate a routine, review or texture clip without filming a creator.

faq.q: Do I need to write prompts to use these templates?
faq.a: No. Pick a beauty style, upload your product photo and generate. Step two can include one short line about the scene if you want.

faq.q: Who are these beauty templates built for?
faq.a: Skincare sellers, beauty teams and agencies that need fresh product clips for social feeds, listings and ads.

faq.q: Can the clip show a routine without a face?
faq.a: Yes. Choose hands, a close-up or a product-only routine when the product should stay the focus.

faq.q: Can I make several skincare scenes from one photo?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the same photo across a routine, review, unboxing or texture scene and generate another angle when needed.

faq.q: Which platforms are beauty clips made for?
faq.a: Use 9:16 clips for TikTok and Reels, or place a square version in a product gallery or feed post.

faq.q: How fast is a beauty video made?
faq.a: A clip is generated in minutes after you start the job, with no studio booking, creator schedule or reshoot.

faq.q: What does a beauty video cost?
faq.a: A 6-, 10-, 15- or 30-second clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits, shown before you run it.

faq.q: Can I use a beauty clip in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your own ads, pages and posts. You remain responsible for claims and disclosures.

visual.overview: A beauty template puts your serum, cream or oil inside a routine shoppers recognize, so the product is easier to picture using.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and preserve its shape, color and visible label area exactly. A hand lifts one dropper of serum above the open amber glass bottle. Frame at counter height with a slow push-in. Soft morning window light remains visible behind the bottle. End with the dropper poised above the full bottle. Sound: quiet room tone and one soft glass click. No music.
